newsitem.title: UK: MEPC sells UK office for 39.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: MEPC sells UK office for 39.6 mln stg.

text.p: UK property company MEPC UK Ltd said on Thursday it had sold the long leasehold interest in a Woking, southern England, office building to an overseas investor for 39.6 million stg.
MEPC said in a statement this reflected a net initial yield of 9.6 percent.
The property is fully occupied and let to 13 tenants, with around 90 percent of the current income secured for a further 16 years.
"We acquired the property vacant as part of our acquisition of the Oldham Estate in 1987. We have since let it and benefited from good returns," Julian Barwick, a director of MEPC UK said.
Barwick said it was now time for the company to move on and re-invest the capital "in situations where we can actively add value".
